test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bungalow"** refers to a low house, with a broad front porch, having either no upper floor or upper rooms set in the roof, typically dormer windows. (बंगला)

 
 
• **Example: **They decided to buy a** bungalow** on the outskirts of the city for a peaceful retirement.
 
 
 
• **"Bungalow" **is the correct spelling of the word. (बंगला)
 
 
• **Example: **The family enjoyed their weekends in the seaside **bungalow.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bungalow**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Banglo** (बंगलो): Incorrect spelling of "Bungalow".

 
 
• **Example: **The word "Banglo" is a misspelling and should be "Bungalow".
 
 
 
• **Bunglow** (बंग्लो): Incorrect spelling of "Bungalow".
 
 
• **Example: **The correct spelling is "Bungalow", not "Bunglow".
 
 
 
• **Banglow** (बंग्लो): Incorrect spelling of "Bungalow".
 
 
• **Example: **The word "Banglow" is another common misspelling of "Bungalow".
